Kit summary

Terror SlashBasicExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.3
Deals 280% ATK DMG and 280% ATK Detonation DMG to a single enemy and inflicts 1 layer of [Wraith] on the target. [Wraith]: Deducts the owner's HP by 10*Kaine's initial SPD each turn before action; this effect can reduce the owner's HP to 1 point at most, up to 10 layers, and will be removed when the owner dies or at the wave transition. If the target has 8 or more layers of [Wraith] and 1% or below HP after Terror Slash deals DMG, slays the target directly.
Necrotic Scythe Lv.1Kaine casts Terror Slash to pursue and attack the enemy with the lowest HP once after an ally casts skills proactively. At the beginning of an enemy's turn, Kaine inflicts 1 layer of [Burn] on them for 2 turns. At the end of anyone's turn, clears allies' recorded DMG.
Necrotic Scythe Lv.3Kaine increases his Turn Meter by 2% at the end of his turn for every 100 of initial SPD above 2000 he has, up to 20% can be increased in this way. If the target has 8 or more layers of [Wraith] and 1% or below HP after Necrotic Impact deals DMG, slays the target directly. At the beginning of an enemy's turn, Kaine casts Terror Slash to pursue and attack the enemy once. When 5 allies with the [HP Deduction] tag are deployed, Kaine additionally increases Turn Meter by 20% at the end of his turn and reduces the CD of the skill by 2 turns after casting the skill proactively.
Necrotic ComboActive
Deals 2 stages of 190% ATK DMG and 190% ATK Detonation DMG each to all enemies and each stage inflicts 1 layer of [Wraith] on them.
Shadow of DeathPassive
Kaine is immune to Turn Meter Reduction effect. When a battle starts, if Kaine's initial SPD is over 2500, reduces his SPD to 2500 and increases his ATK by 50 for every 1 point of SPD reduced, up to 25000 ATK can be increased in this way.
Necrotic ImpactActiveExclusive Lv.2 · Lv.3
Grants all allies [Resolute II] for 2 turns. Deals 3 stages of 190% ATK DMG and 190% ATK Detonation DMG to all enemies each and each stage inflicts 1 layer of [Wraith] on them. Additionally triggers 1 layer of [Wraith] after the third stage of DMG is dealt, up to 6 layers can be triggered.
Necrotic Scythe Lv.2When there is 1 or fewer ally with higher initial SPD than Kaine: 1. Kaine is immune to control effect. 2. At the beginning of each wave, grants all allies [Speed Up II] for 1 turn. 3. At the end of an ally's turn, grants the ally [Speed Up II] for 1 turn. When Kaine deals DMG to a Boss, for every 1 layer of [Wraith] owned by the target, increases the DMG dealt to them by Kaine by 100%. When an enemy gains [Consolidation], Kaine casts Necrotic Impact to the enemy 1 more time at the end of anyone's turn. This effect can be triggered in the next 8 consecutive turns.
Necrotic Scythe Lv.3Kaine increases his Turn Meter by 2% at the end of his turn for every 100 of initial SPD above 2000 he has, up to 20% can be increased in this way. If the target has 8 or more layers of [Wraith] and 1% or below HP after Necrotic Impact deals DMG, slays the target directly. At the beginning of an enemy's turn, Kaine casts Terror Slash to pursue and attack the enemy once. When 5 allies with the [HP Deduction] tag are deployed, Kaine additionally increases Turn Meter by 20% at the end of his turn and reduces the CD of the skill by 2 turns after casting the skill proactively.
Source: game files.

At the beginning of the owner's turn, grants one of the Travelogue Pages randomly to all allies:
